                ++count;
            } else if (!content.contains("_")) {
                ++count;
            } else {
                String[] parts = content.split("_");
                int nonEmpty = 0;
                for (String part : parts) {
                    if (!part.isEmpty()) nonEmpty++;
                }
                count += nonEmpty;
            }
        }
        s = s.replaceAll("\\([^)]*\\)", "_");
        return count;
    }
    int findLongestSegment(String s) {
        s = s.replaceAll("__", "_");
        s = s.replaceAll("\\([^)]*\\)", "_");

        String[] parts = s.split("_", -1);

    String normalizeUnderscores(String s) {
        while (s.contains("__")) {
            s = s.replace("__", "_");
        }
        return s;
    }
    int countMatchingParenSegments(String s) {
        int total = 0;
        Deque<Integer> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '(') {
                stack.push(i);
            } else if (c == ')') {
                if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                    int start = stack.pop() + 1;
                    String segment = s.substring(start, i);
                    if (segment.isEmpty()) {
                        total++;
                    } else if (!segment.contains("_")) {
                        total++;
                    } else {
                        int nonEmpty = 0;
                        for (String part : segment.split("_")) {
                            if (!part.isEmpty()) nonEmpty++;
                        }
                        total += nonEmpty;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Replace parentheses with underscore
        s = s.replaceAll("\\([^()]*\\)", "_");
        return total;
    }
    int computeMaxSegmentLength(String s) {
        s = s.replaceAll("\\([^()]*\\)", "_");
        s = s.replaceAll("__", "_");
        int max = 0;
        StringBuilder cur = new StringBuilder();
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            if (c == '_') {
                max = Math.max(max, cur.length());
                cur.setLength(0);
            } else {
                cur.append(c);
            }
        }
        max = Math.max(max, cur.length());
        return max;
    }
}

                        }

                    inner.setLength(0);
                }
            } else if (depth > 0) {
                inner.append(c);
            }
        }
        // Replace valid parentheses substrings with underscores
